chat.closeBody: You can open chat again from the launcher. Your sessions stay in History.
chat.placeholder: Ask anything about resilience assessments — today or past dates…
chat.rename.title: Rename chat
chat.rename.label: Title
chat.delete.title: Delete this chat?
chat.delete.body: This removes the conversation from your history. This cannot be undone.
chat.editing: Editing an earlier message — sending rewrites the conversation from that point.
chat.consulted: Consulted — not cited in the answer
chat.starter.3: Show the evidence behind community capital
chat.starter.4: Summarize today's report in three bullets
chat.status.slowWarning: Taking longer than usual — server timeout is about {timeoutMin} min. You can Stop and retry.
chat.banner.loop_exhausted: Search limit reached — answer may be incomplete. Try Regenerate or narrow the question.
chat.banner.error: This response could not be completed.
chat.banner.stopped: Stopped — the partial answer was kept. Regenerate for a full answer.
chat.banner.connection_lost: Connection lost before the answer finished. Retry to continue.
